'''ZEKA'''. |checkboxIsSub=No |checkbox-res=No |checkboxPrev=No }} == Biography == == Trivia == * He got the nickname "Supersoldier" (슈퍼솔져) from Korean fans. * He is known as "Game 5 Devil" for almost always winning game 5 in a BO5 match. * He is the first Mid-Laner to achieve the Riot Grand Slam by winning Worlds, MSI, First Stand, and his domestic league. * He is the only player to win all three international Riot tournaments on his first appearance at each event ([[Worlds 2022]], [[MSI 2026]], [[First Stand 2025]]). * He is famous for his melee champions, especially his {{ci|Akali}}, {{ci|Sylas}}, and {{ci|Yone}}. * He is good friends with [[Kingen]].[https://youtu.be/3m8Dk2nerfc?si=sQorxsMAjGR9fBnX&t=328] ''youtube.com'' * Finished S2023 S2 Rank 1 in Korean Solo Queue with 1955 LP. * Reached 1000 kills in the LCK on August 8th, 2024. ** Was the 28th player and 7th Mid-Laner to reach 1000 kills in the LCK. ** His 1000th kill in the LCK was on [[OKSavingsBank BRION]]'s Jungler [[YoungJae]] with {{ci|Jayce}}. * Reached 1500 kills in the LCK on April 16th, 2026. ** Was the 19th player and 6th Mid-Laner to reach 1500 kills in the LCK. ** His 1500th kill in the LCK was on [[DN SOOPers]]'s Support [[Peter (Jeong Yoon-su)|Peter]] with {{ci|Yone}}. {{PlayerStatsTrivia}} === Individual Awards === * First Stand Finals MVP x1 (2025) * LCK Player of the Year x1 (2022) * LCK
